statement: Every triangle-free graph admits a proper coloring with 3 colors.
definitions: Graphs are finite and simple; a proper colouring gives adjacent vertices different colours.
ground_truth_witness: The Grotzsch graph on 11 vertices: outer 5-cycle 0-1-2-3-4-0; mirror vertices 5+i (i = 0..4) with 5+i adjacent to (i+1) mod 5 and (i-1) mod 5; apex 10 adjacent to 5,6,7,8,9 - twenty edges in total (the Mycielskian of C5). Checking all vertex triples shows it contains no triangle, exhaustive backtracking shows it has no proper 3-coloring, and a proper 4-coloring exists, so its chromatic number is 4.
